Marvell and Lumentum to Combine, Creating a Category Leader in AI Connectivity

(NASDAQ: MRVL) and Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement for Marvell to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock transaction. Under the terms of the agreement, Lumentum stockholders will receive a fixed exchange ratio of 4.500 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum common stock they own. The transaction has an implied enterprise value of $115 billion for Lumentum, representing approximately $1,132 per share of Lumentum common stock and a premium of approximately 23.9% based on each company’s unaffected closing share price as of October 28, 2026, the last trading day before market speculation regarding a potential transaction began.

The transaction is expected to close in the first half of calendar year 2028, subject to approval by Marvell and Lumentum stockholders, receipt of regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.

Date of Report: November 1, 2026

The Merger

On November 1, 2026, Marvell Technology, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Marvell”) entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”) with Lumentum Holdings Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Lumentum”), Java Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of Marvell (“Merger Sub I”) and Java Merger Sub II, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of Marvell (“Merger Sub II” and together with Merger Sub I, each a “Merger Sub” and collectively the “Merger Subs”).

At the effective time of the First Merger (the “Effective Time”), each share of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of Lumentum (the “Lumentum Common Stock”) that is issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, subject to certain exceptions in the Merger Agreement, will be converted into the right to receive 4.500 shares of common stock, par value $0.002 per share, of Marvell (the “Marvell Common Stock,” and such ratio, the “Exchange Ratio”), with cash in lieu of fractional shares of Marvell Common Stock payable in accordance with the Merger Agreement (the “Common Stock Merger Consideration”).

At the Effective Time, each share of preferred stock, par value $0.001 per share, of Lumentum designated as Series A Convertible Preferred Stock (the “Lumentum Series A Preferred Stock” and, together with the Lumentum Common Stock, the “Lumentum Capital Stock”) that is issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, subject to certain exceptions in the Merger Agreement, will be converted into the right to receive a number of shares of Marvell Common Stock equal to the product of (a) the number of shares of Lumentum Common Stock into which such share of Lumentum Preferred Stock is convertible pursuant to its terms as of immediately prior to the Effective Time and (b) the Exchange Ratio, with cash in lieu of fractional shares of Marvell Common Stock payable in accordance with the Merger Agreement (the “Preferred Common Stock Merger Consideration”).

However, if a holder of shares of Lumentum Series A Preferred Stock makes an election in accordance with the terms of the Merger Agreement to receive the Merger Consideration in the form of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.002 per share, of Marvell (the “Marvell Series B Preferred Stock,” and such election, a “Preferred Stock Election”), then each share of Lumentum Preferred Stock that is held by such holder immediately prior to the Effective Time will instead be converted into the right to receive one share of Marvell Series B Preferred Stock (the “Series B Preferred Stock Merger Consideration” and together with the Preferred Common Stock Merger Consideration and the Common Stock Merger Consideration, the “Merger Consideration”).
